rules.card_name: Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card

reward_rules.description: 10% cashback on Swiggy App spends for Food Delivery, Instamart and Dineout only. Other Swiggy platforms do not qualify. Minimum transaction Rs. 249.

5% cashback on select online merchant and category spends on eligible online transactions and listed merchants/categories, including Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Cleartrip, Ajio, Netflix, Hotstar, BookMyShow, Meesho, and select merchant/category MCCs. Cleartrip and Nykaa also have instant discounts in addition to cashback.
1% cashback on other spends not covered by the higher cashback categories.

gotchas: The 10% Swiggy cashback applies only to Swiggy Food ordering, Instamart and Dineout; transactions on any other Swiggy platform do not qualify. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.10-11

For the 10% cashback category, the minimum transaction amount is Rs. 249. For the 5% and 1% cashback categories, the minimum transaction amount is Rs. 100. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.15; hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.17

Cashback is calculated on posting date and auto-redeemed against outstanding balance excluding finance charges. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.15; hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.17

The 5% merchant/category table is online-only and only select merchants mapped under the listed MCCs are eligible. Any other MCCs are not eligible for the 5% cashback category. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.11-12

The 5% table explicitly includes Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, ClearTrip, Ajio, Netflix, Hotstar, BookMyShow and Meesho, plus categories such as Apparels, Pharmacies, Pet Stores, Personal Care, electronics, entertainment, travel, discount stores and local cabs. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.11-12

The 1% cashback excludes Fuel, Rent, Government related transactions, EMI, Gaming, Education, Gift Card, Wallet and Jewellery. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.10; hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.12

The fee section states an annual fee of INR 1000 plus applicable taxes, and says the renewal year fee of Rs 1000 is charged from second year onwards. It also says the joining fee of Rs 1000 is waived on spending Rs. 75,000 in the first 90 days, applicable for first year only. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.14
The documents do not state a renewal-fee waiver spend for the annual/renewal fee after the first year. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.14
A revision or later effective-date notice was not found that changes the core cashback rates or fee row in the searched document set. Source: hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.10-18

[hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.15] Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card | Section: 4.1 Cashback T&Cs on Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card

## 4.1 Cashback T&Cs on Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card

- The transaction settled from the merchant will be eligible for Cashback and Posting date of the transaction will be considered for cashback calculation.

- For any transaction against which the posting date is recorded under the next statement, Cashback will be posted in the card account statement in accordance with posting date.

- Payments/credits not initiated by the customer such as Merchant refund/cashback/charge reversals etc. received into the credit card account will not be considered as a payment towards the outstanding of the card. However, such credits will be considered to compute the subsequent month’s dues.

- In order to earn 10% Cashback on eligible transactions using Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card, the cardholder should make a minimum transaction of Rs. 249 using the card.

- In order to earn 5% and 1% Cashback on eligible transactions using Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card, the cardholder should make a minimum transaction of Rs. 100 using the card.

- Cashback can only be earned on eligible transactions as defined by as Table 1.1 (stated above)

- Cashback earned will be calculated based on all the spends across defined cashback categories during the statement period minus any returns or refunds during the same period.

- The principal cardholder will forthwith be disqualified from earning the cashbacks, if Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card is terminated at any time for any reason, whether by the primary Cardholder or the Bank.

- Any remaining Cashback including Cashbacks pending credit into the Swiggy account of the Cardholder shall immediately cease to be valid upon the occurrence of the following:

- a) The cancellation of the Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank credit card

[hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.17] Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card | Section: 4.2 Cashback Redemption

## 4.2 Cashback Redemption

## 4.2.1 T&Cs

- Cashback earned for current billing cycle will be auto redeemed against outstanding amount. Note – Cashback will not get adjusted or auto redeemed against Financial Charges accrued. Cashback auto redemption is solely applicable on outstanding balance excluding the Finance charges.

- For more details on Finance charges please refer Most Important Terms and Conditions.

- In order to earn 10% Cashback on eligible transactions using Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card, the cardholder should make a minimum transaction of Rs. 249 using the card.

- In order to earn 5% and 1% Cashback on eligible transactions using Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card, the cardholder should make a minimum transaction of Rs. 100 using the card.

- Cashback can only be earned on eligible transactions as defined by as Table 1.1 (stated above)

[hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.14] Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card | Section: 3.1 Renewal Year Fee Waiver (Applicable for priced cards)

## 3.1 Renewal Year Fee Waiver (Applicable for priced cards)

- Annual fee of INR 1000+ applicable taxes is charged once to enjoy the benefits of Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card.

- Joining Fee of Rs. 1000 will be waived on spending Rs.75,000 in the first 90 days. (Applicable for first Year only)

- Annual fee will be levied within 120 days. Renewal year fee of Rs 1000 will be charged from second year onwards.

[hdfc_swiggy_ornge_blck_tnc_2026-03.pdf p.13] Swiggy BLCK HDFC Bank Credit Card | Section: Please Click here for card activation guidelines

## Please Click here for card activation guidelines

## 2.7 Additional Offer during Birthday Week

- Additional 10% discount on Swiggy Dineout upto Rs.500 on minimum order value of Rs. 3000. This is over and above 10% cashback on Swiggy Dineout using the card. For detailed T&Cs on Swiggy Dineout, please refer to the offer terms and conditions at the restaurant booking page

- The offer is applicable for a duration of 7 days (3 days prior and 3 days after the birthday). For example – Cardholder bank registered Birthday is on 14th Oct. The eligibility of the offer is from 11th Oct to 17th Oct (both days inclusive).

- Birthday date should be as per the bank records while applying for the card will be considered for the offer.

- The offer is applicable once per cardholder.

- Follow below steps on the Swiggy app in order to redeem –

1. Click on "Claim now" button on Swiggy app main page or Dineout page on Birthday related communication.

2. Select the restaurant of your choice and book your preferred slot

3. Apply the coupon "SWIGGYCARDBDAY" available in the 'Apply Coupon' section while making the payment via Dineout

4. Make the payment using your Swiggy HDFC credit card on Dineout.

- Cardholder are eligible for this offer only post 30 days after card activation. (Ex – if card activation is done on 1st of November, and DOB is 2nd November, offer is not applicable).

- Offer start date : 21st Oct’24

- Swiggy reserves the right, at any time, without prior notice and without assigning any reason whatsoever, to add/alter/modify/change or vary all of these terms and conditions or to replace, wholly or in part, this offer by another offer, whether similar to this offer or not, or to extend or withdraw it altogether
